faq.title: Answers to Your Questions
faq.subtitle: Didn't find an answer? Contact our support

client.q1: How to book a master through AURELLE?
client.a1: Choose a salon or master, view available time slots in the calendar, select a convenient slot and confirm the booking. You will receive a notification via email and in your personal account.
client.q2: Can I cancel or reschedule an appointment?
client.a2: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule an appointment in your personal account 24 hours before the appointed time. Cancellation less than 24 hours in advance may incur a penalty fee according to the salon's policy.
client.q3: Is it safe to pay for services through the platform?
client.a3: Absolutely safe. We use secure payment gateways and do not store your card data. All transactions are encrypted according to PCI DSS standards.

salon.q1: How much does it cost to list a salon on the platform?
salon.a1: Registration and listing basic salon information is free. We take a small commission only from completed bookings. Premium plans with extended features are also available.
salon.q2: How does the online booking system work?
salon.a2: You set up your work schedule, services and prices. Clients book available time slots online, and you receive notifications. The system automatically manages the calendar and reminders.
salon.q3: What analytics does the platform provide?
salon.a3: You get detailed statistics: number of views, new clients, popular services, revenue by period, rating and reviews. All data is available in real-time in your personal account.

master.q1: Can I work as a freelance master?
master.a1: Yes! AURELLE supports solo masters. Create your page, specify services and prices, set up your work schedule. You will get your own link for clients.
master.q2: How to improve my rating on the platform?
master.a2: Quality service is the main factor. Also important: complete profile, quick responses to messages, regular portfolio updates, availability of reviews and adherence to the work schedule.
